question: On the six existing source captures, preserve pixel tracking, local screening and explicit failure fallback while improving V22 accuracy and useful coverage; separately compare gap 0.10 and gap 0.15.

population.statistical_unit: source capture; windows overlap and are not independent subjects or training examples
population.set_role: previously inspected development/regression data, including final frozen regression verification; not held-out generalization
population.excluded: Known playback/transcoded/cropped derivatives are not new captures. Do not read, restore or search deleted _gudb data; no additional source collection in this round.

family_intent.bounded_tracking: Pixel tracking and local screening retained; anchor low-frequency baseline of log-relative color to bound cumulative drift, with explicit reference-free fallback. Numeric settings pending.
family_intent.guarded_fusion: Use the bounded tracking branch and V22 original branch with predefined signal-quality/motion-consensus guard and failure fallback; no reference-dependent branch selection. Rules and numeric settings pending.

bounded_candidate_round.comparison: Each gap10 candidate versus trimmed_gap10; each gap15 candidate versus trimmed_gap15. Cross-gap comparisons are descriptive only.
bounded_candidate_round.reporting: All four modes and all six cases must be retained and reported; no per-video oracle, best-window oracle, best-reference-shift selection or post-score candidate renaming.
bounded_candidate_round.default_selection: The primary gap10 family and corresponding gap15 option must be designated before new inference. Do not silently promote whichever candidate scores best.
bounded_candidate_round.further_iterations: A failed round may inform a separately registered development round; retain this entire round. A fresh rerun on these same captures is still regression testing.

window_protocol.trailing_frames: Retain on full sample timeline; do not invent a partial final HR window.
window_protocol.duration: Use frames/fps and actual step/window durations. Never multiply overlapping accepted window count by 10 to claim unique monitored seconds.
window_protocol.identities: One canonical grid per case shared by every compared mode; exact frame identities and finite/missing flags, numeric serialization checks atol=1e-9 rtol=0 unless a distinct earlier-frozen metadata convention applies.

reference_protocol.reference_access: Reference files accessible only to offline evaluator after every frozen prediction has completed. No reference, HR target, source-specific HR range, alignment fit or ground-truth-based window choice in inference.
reference_protocol.data1_utc_rule: Keep epoch ns as int64; subtract integer origin before conversion to seconds. Positive shift puts video start later on reference clock. Export UTC as nullable Int64, not float64.
reference_protocol.data1_reference: User-designated Polar HR notifications from host_utc_ns/hr_bpm. Original mtime-based synchronization estimate, not hardware sync or ECG.
reference_protocol.ubfc_reference: Read retained 3x1547 ground_truth.txt; relative device time = row3 minus first time; merge duplicate device timestamps by averaging row2 HR. Device-HR mean, not ECG and not PPG morphology ground truth.
reference_protocol.window_reference: Mean of finite positive HR in nominal [center-5,center+5). Window inside first retained reference time through last plus original median interval, at least two values; for data1 internal gap <=2s. Reuse pinned V22 reference_for unchanged.
reference_protocol.synthetic_reference: Known generator 72 bpm, separate engineering control; excluded from human accuracy macro.
reference_protocol.no_reference: MAE, RMSE, Bias, P5, R5, LoA and reference-H1 SNR are null/NA, never zero.
reference_protocol.sensitivity: Report all seven shifts with own/common/new/lost results, never select or average shifts into the primary result. These shifts are not a confidence interval. Opposite conclusions across shifts are disclosed.
reference_protocol.morphology: No qualified synchronized waveform truth in this set; r_wave is NA. Reference HR calculable does not establish audited physiological signal quality.

estimators.readout_integrity: Both final HR readouts must reproduce from the actual saved base waveform using the declared frozen readout. Respect accepted mask; rejected finite diagnostic peaks never count as output. No sine-wave synthesis from HR.
estimators.timing_claim: Offline waveform processing and offline DP must not be labelled online or real-time. Local peak readout alone does not establish end-to-end causality.

metric_definitions.Nplanned: All canonical planned windows including rejected and reference-ineligible windows.
metric_definitions.Noutput: accepted AND finite prediction in the selected estimator.
metric_definitions.Nref: finite positive reference eligible under unchanged protocol, independent of candidate output.
metric_definitions.MAE_bpm: mean(abs(error)) on valid windows; NA when no valid windows.
metric_definitions.RMSE_bpm: sqrt(mean(error**2)) on valid windows; NA when no valid windows.
metric_definitions.SD_error_bpm_ddof1: sample SD(error), NA with <2 valid windows
metric_definitions.LoA: Bias +/-1.96*sample SD; descriptive limits only, not a CI or population-valid 95% claim with overlapping windows.
metric_definitions.R5_all_reference_pct: 100*N(abs(error)<=5)/Nref; zero if Nref>0 and no correct output, NA if Nref=0.
metric_definitions.pair_definition: Common/added/lost from same-estimator output masks, independent of ground-truth values. All subsets keep original full Nplanned and Nref denominators; subset Nvalid and Nwithin5 change.
metric_definitions.R5_decomposition: delta Nwithin5 = common_after Nwithin5 - common_before Nwithin5 + added_after Nwithin5 - lost_before Nwithin5; divide by common full Nref for delta R5.
metric_definitions.global_common: All modes same-estimator intersection is descriptive only; same-gap baseline/candidate pairwise common is used for gate.

coverage_and_continuity.duration_definitions: Finite/missing sample runs use sample count/fps; longest rejected HR grid run = longest consecutive rejected count*actual_step_s, also report first-last center span=(count-1)*actual_step_s. Include boundary gaps; report internal-only waveform gaps separately.
coverage_and_continuity.interpretation: Finite saved waveform coverage is an output-availability metric, not validated morphology or physiological accuracy. HR windows, waveform generation, neighboring-window coverage and sample interpolation remain distinct. No last-HR hold or fabricated finite waveform counted as new observed evidence.
frontend_and_fallback_audit: Face detection/flow source and rgb_valid masks versus same-gap baseline
Explicit window/branch selection and rejection reason counts
Which accepted windows depend on fallback, interpolation or neighbor contribution
No reference-driven quality score or fallback choice

reference_H1_SNR.window: one full-window periodic Hann, mean detrend
reference_H1_SNR.power: one-sided density-scaled periodogram; 10log10(reference H1 band power / remaining .7-3.5Hz power)
reference_H1_SNR.eligibility: accepted HR window AND complete finite saved base segment AND eligible reference; no algorithm-selected peak in numerator
reference_H1_SNR.claims: SNR is specific to this HR-frequency band definition. It neither proves recovered pulse morphology nor supplies accuracy without a reference.

V24_upgrade_gate.strict_improvement: after < before - 1e-6 for lower-is-better; after > before + 1e-6 for higher-is-better. This is numerical tolerance, not a validated clinically meaningful threshold.
V24_upgrade_gate.source_balanced_MAE: mean of the two per-capture MAEs, equal source weights
V24_upgrade_gate.source_balanced_RMSE: sqrt(mean of the two per-capture RMSE**2)), equal source MSE weights; not arithmetic mean of RMSEs
primary_error_rules: Both source-balanced MAE and source-balanced RMSE strictly improve in each required scope.
Each real-reference capture MAE and RMSE is noninferior in own and same-gap pairwise-common windows.
Empty reference or empty valid own/common windows fails; never remove a hard capture from macro.
V24_upgrade_gate.local_peak_guardrail: Each real-reference capture MAE/RMSE noninferior in own and same-gap pairwise-common windows with 1e-6 tolerance; no strict improvement required. Report full local gate diagnostics.
V24_upgrade_gate.R5_rules: For both readouts, each real-reference capture own R5 and pairwise-common R5 must not decrease. Keep full Nref on pairwise scopes.
V24_upgrade_gate.coverage_macro: Arithmetic mean of per-capture C_out_pct, and separately arithmetic mean of per-capture finite_sample_pct; each of five human captures has weight 1/5.
coverage_rules: Both human macro HR-output coverage and human macro finite saved-waveform coverage strictly increase.
Each human capture HR-output coverage and finite saved-waveform coverage is noninferior.
For readout-specific masks, require coverage noninferiority for both readouts.
V24_upgrade_gate.synthetic_rule: Exclude from human macros. Both readouts own/common MAE, RMSE, R5 and output coverage, plus finite waveform coverage, must be noninferior. Improvement below baseline zero error is not required.
V24_upgrade_gate.continuity_and_SNR_role: Always report each-case longest gaps and paired SNR. They are additional explicit V23 compatibility checks, not silently added V24 pass/fail rules.
engineering_rules: Every frozen mode and all six source videos complete successfully.
Candidate-specific source hashes, input identities and parameters match its V24 pre-inference manifest; do not require V23 module hashes.
V22 baseline metrics and SNR reproduced with pinned scoring functions.
Saved-waveform final HR replay, validity/provenance/neighbor coverage and fallback audit pass.
No reference supplied to inference; alignment and candidate identity not altered after scores.
Meaningful boundary/unit tests pass and independent metric/denominator/UTC audit passes.
V24_upgrade_gate.deployment: Only the predeclared primary gap10 candidate passing this gate is eligible for default upgrade after separately reported installed-entry verification; named gap15 evaluated versus its own V22 baseline. Otherwise retain current production entry and label candidate experimental. Evaluator never deploys.

V23_compatibility_gate.semantic_candidate_mapping: Replace only baseline/candidate names with matching-gap V24 identity; evaluate original V23 own/common error, R5, each-case HR/waveform coverage/longest-gap, paired-SNR, synthetic <=1bpm and original meaningful-improvement disjunction.
V23_compatibility_gate.label: V23 original compatibility gate; additional constraints differ from V24 aggregate AND-improvement rule, so the two gates are not a mathematical subset relation.
V23_compatibility_gate.engineering_mapping: Use the V24 frozen manifest and declared architecture/replay contract for engineering validity. Any original V23 unchanged-backend assumption that V24 intentionally changes must be listed, never silently asserted or used to exclude its scores.

evaluator_adapter.optional_mechanism_diagnostics: Actual V24 branch/pixel/fallback schema pending implementation; bind before inference, not inferred from reference results.
evaluator_adapter.source_hash_resolution: Baseline expected hashes from V22 protocol; each new mode hashes/config from V24 protocol_before_validation.json. New source module names allowed when explicitly frozen; never substitute V23 hashes or hardcode V23 candidates/backends.
evaluator_adapter.readout_schema_treatment: Respect legacy POS/CHROM diagnostic peak exception on rejected diffuse_spectrum windows, always apply accepted mask. Final fusion rejected readout columns must be NaN.
evaluator_adapter.geometry_contract: Common frame/time/source geometry if deliberately unchanged must be checked separately; intentional V24 signal-validity changes are measured and disclosed, not force-equal to V23 or omitted from evaluation.

required_validation: Nvalid<=Nref<=Nplanned; Nvalid<=Noutput<=Nplanned; zero-output versus no-reference cases.
P5/R5/C_ref arithmetic and added/lost/common correct-output decomposition.
Case-balanced macro errors and coverage computed from full declared population.
Nanoseconds roundtrip as nullable Int64 and fixed seven-shift reference centers.
Saved-waveform readout reproduction and sample provenance.
Source/flags/missingness exact checks with explicit serialization tolerance for numbers.
All original inputs unchanged before/after; output directory cannot overwrite previous evidence.
limitations: Only two human captures have usable HR references; data1 synchronization is estimated.
All six captures are development/regression data already inspected in prior rounds; a final frozen rerun does not become an unseen validation set.
Five source captures need not mean five distinct people; identity independence is not established.
597 overlapping windows are not 597 independent samples, participants or training records.
No-reference accuracy, qualified morphology correlation and clinical validation are unavailable.
Small numerical gains can pass the stated numerical gate but are not automatically practically meaningful; report actual magnitudes.
